import pandas as pd

# File paths for all source tables
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_6/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_6/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_6/training_2.csv",

    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_6/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_6/training_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_6/training_8.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_6/training_9.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_6/training_10.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_6/training_11.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_6/training_12.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_6/training_13.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_6/training_14.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_6/training_15.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_6/training_16.csv",
]

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# Concatenate all DataFrames (UNION)
combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Remove duplicates to match target uniqueness on (country, cpi)
combined_df = combined_df.drop_duplicates(subset=['country', 'cpi'])

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
combined_df['country'] = combined_df['country'].astype(str)
combined_df['cpi'] = combined_df['cpi'].astype(float)

# Save the final target table
combined_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_6/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
